description: Feature lookup. The application asks 'may I show the time tracking?' and gets one boolean. Patterns exist so a tier can grant a whole area without listing every switch in it.
notes: Matching is exact unless the granted entry ends in '*', which matches any suffix including the empty one.
A '*' on its own grants everything. Used by the enterprise tier of some products.
The wildcard is only ever on the granted side. A query is always a literal name - otherwise an application could ask 'do I have anything?' and get a yes.

cases.why: The free tier with nothing enabled, or a licence that failed to load.
'export.*' should also answer 'export.' - the empty suffix is a suffix.
'export.*' grants things under export, not the literal name 'export'. Being strict here keeps the tier tables honest.
'export.*' must not grant 'exportable' - a wildcard is not a substring search.
An empty feature name is a bug in the caller, not an entitlement.
Feature names come from the tier table and are always lower case. Folding case here would hide typos in that table.
Only the granted side may carry a wildcard.
